sources.summary: Page 41 explicitly identifies maincubes Three GmbH, Rechenzentrum maincubes FRA03, Schwalbach am Taunus, Am Kronberger Hang 7, separately from its business address Tilsiter Straße 1 in Frankfurt. Six associated stack rows publish zone-prefixed UTM coordinates. The first complete row supplies east 32466776 and north 5556595. The registration form specifies ETRS89/UTM for these chimney fields; the point is transformed from EPSG:4647 to WGS84. It anchors the named existing campus, not a building centre, footprint or data hall. Page 42 separately identifies FRA02 at number 2b. The attached application explicitly identifies Hatchworks LLC, Google Data Center, Fort Wayne and Project Zodiac Phase 3 together. The numeric government project reference is retained as a campus anchor; no building or phase centre is inferred.
